### C.A.S
- this is a attempt to learn singing in a fluid way by getting scrore for my singing and trying to improve it
- checkout [this perplexity chat](https://www.perplexity.ai/search/i-have-a-project-idea-that-is-7_epDlP_TsCH0c.GNSLkWA) for reference

### Overall Plan 
- the project is divided into 4 steps

#### Step 1
- record the Audio from the best mic I have(laptop , phone and tws) and try to reduce noise as much as possible. then use FFT and other audio processing techniques to clean the noise, enhance the vocal and prepare the audio for next level processing 

#### Step 2
- in this phase we will try to extract the lyrical information and the timing it occurred. if my lyrics is not perfectly captured then there is something wrong with my pronounciation 

#### Step 3 
- get the pitch information for every point of the song and match it with actual song 

#### Step 4
- collect all these data and use LLM to get the detailed review of my singing and also get the report for possible improvement
